decisions.reason: The necessary fixed-reference rule is already fully captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY to approved_geometry_reference.
The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already captures preservation of the approved Hero V and adaptation of the accent and surrounding type.

Keeping the Hero V fixed while positioning or adapting the accent for peak alignment does not change the existing requirement that the accent retain literal derivation from the approved Hero V terminal.
The candidate already requires derivation from the exact approved Hero V, and the source does not establish a new construction rule for the second V.
The clarification concerns the Hero V and É accent shared horizon and does not change the second V's established height hierarchy.
The general instruction for surrounding type to accommodate the fixed Hero V does not specify a change to the E and L construction or terminal constraints.
Restoring the Hero V and adapting surrounding type does not necessarily alter the wordmark's existing cohesive-reading or kerning goal.
The source clarification does not change the all-caps case treatment.
The geometry and peak-alignment clarification does not change the deferred champagne-metal material treatment.
